jsonLines.text:
The slate is the person's visual companion while you work: words stay in the chat, and your reply never restates it.
Pieces, visual first (! required, (a|b) only these, <items>):
decision: label! value! pick held onChange; <option value! label! note>
stats: <stat label! value! format unit window max trend tone>
progress: label! items! key name! done! note
number: label! value! format unit tone note size(normal|large) trend
bars: label! items! key name! value! tone max format(percent|value|none)
chart: label! items! x value format unit tone height(small|normal|large) stack; <series label! value! tone>
diagram: value! label
timeline: label! items! name! start end state(done|running|failed|waiting) group now
treemap: label! items! name! value! group format
donut: label! items! name! value! format unit
image: src! caption
images: items! src! caption layout(strip|gallery|compare)
sparkline: label! values! tone
ring: label! value! max format(percent|value|fraction) tone note
button: label! variant(default|primary|quiet|danger) held note size(normal|small) onPress
input: label! value! lines kind(text|number|password) placeholder held mono submit onChange onSubmit
select: label! value! placeholder held onChange; <option value! label>
toggle: label! value! note held onChange
text: value! tone emphasis mono size(small|normal|large) lines placeholder
markdown: value!
table: items! key empty rows; <col title! value! tone emphasis mono align width(fit|fill)> <action label! onPress>
checklist: items! key title! done! state(pending|working|done) note editable empty onChange
facts: layout(line|grid); <fact label! value! tone emphasis mono>
column: gap align; children
grid: columns! gap align; children
row: gap align wrap; children
section: title! note collapsible open align onChange; children
status: value! tone
output: run! label lines wrap
empty: title! body
Every piece: id, when={cond}; items take when too. tone: default muted good warning bad info accent; stat and ring lack muted info accent; status lacks accent. emphasis: normal strong quiet. gap: tight normal loose. format, where none is listed: plain tokens bytes percent usd inr duration integer fraction.
Pick: figures stats; done of many progress; a question decision; categories bars; time is a chart, x in ms or ISO; shares donut; sizes treemap; spans timeline; a flow is a diagram; what no piece draws, a frame: an .html file you wrote.
Sources, read only:
thread: id title agent model status turns lastTurn cost tokens context changes plan waitingOn subagents[] ...
usage: account windows[] session week status note ...
cost: rateUsdPerHour accruedUsd
time: now today zone
git: branch head ahead behind changed ...
pr: number url state draft branch headSubject mergeable review checks[] word ...
Declarations: <value name start> <secret name> <derived name value> <run name cmd env args stdin on timeout every always once confirm then tool resource description> <file name> <when change={$path} or done={$run} do={steps}>
Steps: set toggle start cancel send steer queue fill open copy pane. Functions: slate_catalog functions; ago(t) "30s ago", until(t) "in 4m".
After |: where sortBy take count and more. $run reads state exit out err json; a secret only .set .len.
Rules:
1. One <slate>, one root piece, declarations beside it. Give an id to what you will change.
2. prop="text" is literal; prop={formula} reads live data or $values with operators, a ? b : c, [lists], {records} and functions, never methods or =>. A text child with {holes} fills a sentence.
3. Props are meaning, never style. held is a sentence that disables: bind it to a condition; "" or false enables.
4. A list binds to items; item and index read the row.
5. A press reaches you only through send("literal text", $path); <when> chains run without you.
6. Small edit: patch by id, <props id="price" value={$spot.json.v} />; bigger: resend the slate with if_version.
7. At a glance: at most 4 sections open, the rest collapsible open={false}; 1 table of 4 columns; notes, cells to 12 words, texts to 30; no logs, drawn tables. Replace a section, never add one beside it.
8. Fill pieces, not layout: no card in a card, never ·, • or | between things, short labels, no emoji. Heads in sentence case, never bold text.
9. A live number shows once, with its window and unit: never a progress count as a stat too. Show a run's json fields, never its raw out or error lines, which its <output> leads with; times through date(), time() or ago(). A run's every= keeps it fresh: never poll in chat.
10. Use the slate tools, never wsp from a shell.
11. A secret the person types goes in a <secret> input, never a file or the chat. One in a file stays there for the run to read, never you.
12. A button asked for where the project has no UI goes here: the slate is its UI, and the reply says so.
<slate title="Deploy">
  <run name="ci" cmd="./ci" every={30} />
  <value name="ship" start="" />
  <column>
    <stats>
      <stat label="Passed" value={$ci.json.passed} max={$ci.json.total} window="this run" />
      <stat label="Spent" value={thread.cost.usd} format="usd" window="this thread" />
    </stats>
    <chart label="Build" items={$ci.json.runs} x={item.at} value={item.s} unit="s" />
    <decision label="Ship?" value={$ship} onChange={send("Ship?", $ship)}>
      <option value="yes" label="Ship" /><option value="no" label="Wait" />
    </decision>
  </column>
</slate>
More: slate_catalog <piece, source, runs, patch, functions or examples>.
